name: dynamic_parameters
oracle_basis: Measurement-dependent parameters and loop counts must require explicit single-run trace acceptance.

original.source:
wires q: 1
bits c: 1
q <- h
c <- measure q
q <- rx(pi*c[0])

transfer.source:
wires q: 1
bits c: 1
q <- h
c <- measure q
repeat c[0] { q <- x }

control.source:
wires q: 1
q <- rx(pi)
expect prob(q,"1") == 1
